overview: Comprehensive overview of financial planning and analysis
track_kpis: What KPIs do you track or plan to track?
track_kpis_help: This section tracks your key performance indicators. List metrics like CAC, LTV, gross margin, churn rate, monthly active users, conversion rate, ARPU. AI can suggest relevant metrics for your business. Use this section to measure performance. Chat with AI to learn about KPIs or get industry-specific recommendations.
revenue_expectations_help: This section defines your revenue expectations. Provide monthly or annual estimates, with ranges for different stages. AI can suggest ranges based on similar startups. Use this section for revenue planning. Chat with AI to understand revenue expectations or get benchmarking help.
list_revenue_streams_help: This section lists your revenue streams. Include subscription, transaction fees, licensing, professional services, hardware sales, API usage. AI can suggest additional revenue streams. Use this section for monetization strategy. Chat with AI to explore revenue models or get diversification ideas.
cogs_description: Calculate your cost of goods sold.
monthly_cogs: What is your monthly cost of goods sold?
monthly_cogs_help: This section identifies your cost of goods sold. Include cloud hosting, delivery costs, support staff, payment gateway fees, software licenses. AI can help estimate typical COGS ranges. Use this section for cost analysis. Chat with AI to learn COGS calculation or get industry benchmarks.
opex_categories: What are your operating expense categories?
opex_categories_help: This section captures your operating expenses. Include salaries, marketing, office rent, software subscriptions, legal, travel, research and development. AI can recommend standard benchmarks. Use this section for expense planning. Chat with AI to understand operating expense categories or get cost optimization tips.
capital_expenditures_help: This section identifies capital expenditures. Include equipment, servers, vehicles, machinery, or one-time building. AI can suggest capital expenditure options. Use this section for investment planning. Chat with AI to understand capex vs opex or get investment planning help.
formatting_statements: What format do you want for the financial statements?
formatting_statements_help: This section produces your financial statements. Choose monthly, quarterly, annually, or 3-5 year projections. AI will calculate based on your inputs. Use this section for financial reporting. Chat with AI to understand financial statements or get formatting recommendations.
financial_ratios_calculated: What financial ratios do you want to calculate?
financial_ratios_help: This section calculates key financial ratios. Includes profitability, efficiency, liquidity, and growth ratios. AI will calculate all key ratios. Use this section for financial analysis. Chat with AI to learn financial ratios or get interpretation help.
complete_financial: You have successfully completed the entire financial model.
